fire.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled; // S7: a brazier's flame on two crossed quads: noise scrolls upward, the flame narrows and breaks up with // height, white-hot at the root and red at the tips. Additive, one noise fetch pair, no depth or screen read. uniform sampler2D noise_pack : filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; uniform vec3 core_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.9, 0.6); uniform vec3 mid_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.45, 0.08); uniform vec3 tip_color : source_color = vec3(0.7, 0.08, 0.02); uniform float strength = 1.6; uniform float speed = 1.1; varying float v_phase; void vertex() { v_phase = MODEL_MATRIX[3].x * 0.37 + MODEL_MATRIX[3].z * 0.61; // The top of the flame leans and wobbles. float h = 1.0 - UV.y; VERTEX.x += sin(TIME * 5.0 + v_phase * 7.0 + h * 3.0) * 0.06 * h; VERTEX.z += cos(TIME * 4.3 + v_phase * 5.0) * 0.05 * h; } void fragment() { float h = 1.0 - UV.y; // 0 at the root, 1 at the tip vec2 uv = vec2(UV.x * 0.5 + v_phase, UV.y * 0.7 + TIME * speed); float n = texture(noise_pack, uv).b * 0.6 + texture(noise_pack, uv * 2.3 + 0.4).g * 0.4; float width = mix(0.48, 0.06, h); float shape = 1.0 - smoothstep(width * 0.4, width, abs(UV.x - 0.5) + (n - 0.5) * 0.25 * (0.3 + h)); float body = shape * smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, h) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.45 + n * 0.5, 1.0, h)); vec3 color = mix(mix(core_color, mid_color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, h + (1.0 - shape) * 0.5)), tip_color, smoothstep(0.35, 0.95, h)); ALBEDO = color * body * strength; ALPHA = 1.0; }
ground.gdshader: shader_type spatial; // The map's ground: trodden earth, dry grass and Roman paving blended by a small paint map (GroundPaint, // R = paving, G = grass, the rest earth) with noisy edges, a large-scale shade so the tiling does not show, // and puddles where the wet amount reaches. World-space mapping, so it needs no UVs. // Cost: six texture fetches per pixel (paint map, two noise scales, three surface tiles); flagged in the report. // M2W1 detail path: eight (paint, place map, two noise scales, four surface tiles). uniform sampler2DArray surfaces : filter_linear_mipmap_anisotropic, repeat_enable; uniform sampler2D paint_map : filter_linear, repeat_disable; uniform sampler2D noise_pack : filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; uniform float map_size_m = 160.0; uniform vec3 layer_ids = vec3(10.0, 11.0, 12.0); // earth, grass, paving uniform vec3 tiles_per_m = vec3(0.333, 0.4, 0.25); uniform vec3 earth_color : source_color = vec3(0.42, 0.34, 0.26); uniform vec3 grass_color : source_color = vec3(0.36, 0.4, 0.2); uniform vec3 grass_dry_color : source_color = vec3(0.5, 0.44, 0.22); uniform vec3 paving_color : source_color = vec3(0.6, 0.57, 0.52); uniform float macro_per_m = 0.027; uniform float macro_strength = 0.3; uniform float edge_noise = 0.4; uniform float wet = 0.0; uniform float wet_dark = 0.62; uniform float wet_roughness = 0.12; uniform float puddle_level = 0.62; uniform float puddle_soft = 0.08; // M2W1 ground detail (data/art_ground_detail.json, graphics preset art_ground_detail_enabled). Off = the S2 path // below the branch, unchanged. On: eight fetches instead of six (paint, the place map, the mid and near noise, // earth, grass, paving and rock tiles). The broad ~60 m patches are the place map's A (the 360 m noise tile's G, // baked at load); the 90 m tile's G gives ~15 m and its B ~2-3 m grain; the near noise (4 m tile) within ~10 m. uniform bool detail_enabled = false; uniform float detail_large_m = 360.0; uniform float detail_mid_m = 90.0; uniform float detail_near_m = 4.0; uniform vec3 earth_ochre : source_color = vec3(0.62, 0.5, 0.34); uniform vec3 earth_umber : source_color = vec3(0.4, 0.31, 0.22); uniform vec3 earth_worn : source_color = vec3(0.7, 0.62, 0.48); uniform float earth_worn_amount = 0.35; uniform float earth_contrast = 1.3; uniform vec3 grass_lush : source_color = vec3(0.33, 0.42, 0.18); uniform vec3 grass_dry : source_color = vec3(0.6, 0.54, 0.3); uniform float grass_contrast = 1.5; uniform float bare_amount = 0.6; uniform float bare_level = 0.62; uniform float creep_amount = 0.5; uniform float rock_layer = 8.0; uniform float rock_tiles_per_m = 0.2; uniform vec3 rock_color : source_color = vec3(0.56, 0.53, 0.48); uniform float rock_slope_start = 0.06; // 1 - normal.y (0.06 ~ 20 degrees) uniform float rock_slope_end = 0.12; // (0.12 ~ 28 degrees) uniform float rock_noise = 0.08; uniform float rock_over_paving = 0.85; uniform float rock_contrast = 0.9; uniform float rock_scree = 0.45; uniform float earth_bump = 0.5; uniform float rock_bump = 0.35; uniform vec3 paving_edge_color : source_color = vec3(0.34, 0.28, 0.21); uniform float paving_edge = 0.5; uniform float paving_joint_grass = 0.6; uniform float slab_tint = 0.25; uniform float warp_m = 1.5; uniform float macro_value = 0.22; uniform float near_detail_m = 10.0; uniform float near_strength = 0.25; uniform float near_bump = 0.6; uniform float fade_start_m = 25.0; uniform float fade_end_m = 140.0; uniform float fade_amount = 0.75; // M2W1 astraB: the place map (scripts/visual/place_map.gd, built at map load from the placed pieces; R trodden, // G shelter, B contact, A the broad noise that used to be the 360 m noise fetch) and the citadel hill's bands. // Still eight fetches: paint, place, mid noise, near noise and the four surface tiles. place_enabled 0 (no place // map: a material made outside a map build) reads no masks and a flat broad noise. uniform sampler2D place_map : filter_linear, repeat_disable; uniform float place_enabled = 0.0; uniform vec3 trodden_color : source_color = vec3(0.62, 0.55, 0.45); uniform vec4 compacted_soil : source_color = vec4(0.0); // alpha enables the map-local soil palette uniform float trodden_amount = 0.0; uniform float trodden_contrast = 0.35; uniform float trodden_smooth = 0.7; uniform vec3 shelter_color : source_color = vec3(0.3, 0.29, 0.2); uniform float shelter_amount = 0.0; uniform float shelter_grass = 0.0; uniform float contact_dark = 0.0; uniform float open_dark = 0.0; uniform float open_calm = 0.0; uniform float open_flat = 0.0; // M2W1 r2b: 0 = the astraB patches; 1 = open ground takes one mid earth / grass colour uniform float near_break = 0.0; uniform float hill_amount = 0.0; uniform float hill_from_m = 0.4; uniform float hill_skirt_m = 5.0; uniform float hill_crown_m = 17.0; uniform float hill_band_m = 3.2; uniform float hill_band_noise_m = 2.5; uniform vec2 hill_band_tilt = vec2(0.03, -0.02); uniform vec3 hill_skirt_color : source_color = vec3(0.34, 0.29, 0.24); uniform vec3 hill_ochre_a : source_color = vec3(0.62, 0.46, 0.3); uniform vec3 hill_ochre_b : source_color = vec3(0.5, 0.38, 0.27); uniform vec3 hill_crown_color : source_color = vec3(0.82, 0.78, 0.7); uniform float hill_rock_keep = 0.5; uniform float hill_paving_absorb = 0.0; // Storm puddles and wet ground (defaults: the item-4 look). uniform float puddle_roughness = 0.04; uniform float puddle_specular = 0.9; uniform float wet_rough_vary = 0.0; uniform float puddle_far_m = 100000.0; // puddles fade out between half this and this camera distance uniform float ground_specular = 0.5; // dry ground's specular (0.5 = the item-4 look); lower = less sheen towards the sun // Optional transition from the final painted texels into continuous, world-space skirt colour. // PLACEHOLDERS (M2CX2, OQ-ART-WORLD): the verge numbers in fragment() (start map_size_m*0.43, noise widths 46 and 65, // fade widths +78 and -18, far-field radii 285/780, grass mixes 0.68/0.95/0.36/0.69) are trial values tuned by eye // for alesia_500 only. Off on every other map (edge_blend_on = 0). Move them to art_backdrop.json skirt before // another map turns the blend on. uniform float backdrop_edge_blend_m = 0.0; varying vec3 v_world; varying vec3 v_normal_world; // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) shades in sRGB space: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB is true there and the source_color // uniforms above arrive unconverted, so the texture, contrast, macro and wet factors below (worked out for linear // colours) pushed the ground's sRGB values around on the web. There, takes each colour to linear, the // albedo is worked out exactly as on Mobile and hands it over in sRGB. Mobile and Forward+ compile // c and c as (c), unchanged. #define W1A_LIN(c) (c) #define W1A_OUT(c) (c) void vertex() { v_world = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz; v_normal_world = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(NORMAL, 0.0)).xyz; } void fragment() { vec2 p = v_world.xz; float edge_distance = max(abs(p.x), abs(p.y)) - map_size_m * 0.5; float edge_blend_on = step(0.01, backdrop_edge_blend_m); float radius_m = length(p); float verge_start = map_size_m * 0.43; if (detail_enabled) { vec2 ground_uv = p / map_size_m + 0.5; vec4 paint_d = texture(paint_map, ground_uv); vec4 P = texture(place_map, ground_uv); vec4 M = texture(noise_pack, p / detail_mid_m + vec2(0.71, 0.29)); vec4 Nn = texture(noise_pack, p / detail_near_m + vec2(0.13, 0.53)); // Outside the ground square (the backdrop skirt) and without a place map: no masks, a flat broad noise. float inside = place_enabled * (1.0 - step(0.5, max(abs(ground_uv.x - 0.5), abs(ground_uv.y - 0.5)))); float interior = 1.0 - edge_blend_on * smoothstep(-18.0, 0.0, edge_distance); // Spread the paint transition over a broken, radial verge that starts inside the square. // The two meshes sample the same pattern and grass coverage on either side of their seam. float verge_m = radius_m - verge_start + (M.a - 0.5) * 46.0; float verge = edge_blend_on * smoothstep(0.0, backdrop_edge_blend_m + 78.0, verge_m); float far_field = smoothstep(285.0, 780.0, radius_m + (M.a - 0.5) * 65.0); float verge_grass = mix(mix(0.68, 0.95, M.a), mix(0.36, 0.69, M.a), far_field); P = mix(vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, mix(0.5, M.a, verge)), P, inside * interior); paint_d = mix(paint_d, vec4(0.0, verge_grass, 0.0, 1.0), verge); vec4 L = vec4(mix(M.a, 1.0 - P.a, 0.5), P.a, 0.0, 0.0); // the broad noise (was a 360 m noise fetch) float dist = length(v_world - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD); float far_k = smoothstep(fade_start_m, fade_end_m, dist) * fade_amount; // tiling detail fades into macro colour float near_k = 1.0 - smoothstep(near_detail_m * 0.5, near_detail_m, dist); vec2 warp = (M.rg - 0.5) * warp_m; // bends the tiles' grid a little so the repeat does not line up float paving = smoothstep(0.42, 0.58, paint_d.r + (M.b - 0.5) * edge_noise * 0.9 + (M.g - 0.5) * edge_noise * 0.3); // The citadel hill (the only ground above the plain): its height drives the bands; the paint's pale paving // halo at its foot goes under the base skirt (the summit's paving stays). float h = v_world.y; float hill_w = smoothstep(hill_from_m, hill_from_m + 1.0, h) * hill_amount * interior; paving *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.05, hill_from_m + 0.6, h) * (1.0 - smoothstep(hill_crown_m, hill_crown_m + 2.0, h)) * hill_paving_absorb; float trod = P.r * (1.0 - paving); float shel = P.g * (1.0 - paving) * (1.0 - trod * 0.6) * (1.0 - hill_w); float openness = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, max(P.r, P.g))) * inside * interior * (1.0 - hill_w); // Rock and scree on the slopes (the hill's steepest is 29 degrees: planar xz stretches 14% there at most). // It also covers most of the paint's paving there (looks only: the paint map and footsteps are unchanged). float slope = 1.0 - normalize(v_normal_world).y; float rock = smoothstep(rock_slope_start, rock_slope_end, slope + (M.b - 0.5) * rock_noise + (M.g - 0.5) * rock_noise); paving *= 1.0 - rock * rock_over_paving; float grass_paint = smoothstep(0.38, 0.62, paint_d.g + (M.r - 0.5) * edge_noise + (L.g - 0.5) * 0.25); // Bare worn patches and stone scatter inside the grass; sparse dry grass creeping into the earth. float bare = smoothstep(bare_level, bare_level + 0.1, M.g * 0.65 + L.r * 0.35 + (M.b - 0.5) * 0.15) * bare_amount; float grass = grass_paint * (1.0 - bare) * (1.0 - paving); float creep = (1.0 - grass_paint) * smoothstep(0.55, 0.78, L.g * 0.5 + M.g * 0.35 + M.b * 0.15) * creep_amount * (1.0 - paving); // Trodden ground has no grass; sheltered ground grows weeds and grass in pockets. grass *= 1.0 - trod * 0.95; creep *= 1.0 - trod; grass = max(grass, shel * shelter_grass * smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, M.g * 0.5 + Nn.r * 0.25 + M.b * 0.25)); rock *= 1.0 - paving; vec4 te = texture(surfaces, vec3((p + warp) * tiles_per_m.x, layer_ids.x)); vec4 tg = texture(surfaces, vec3((p - warp) * tiles_per_m.y, layer_ids.y)); vec4 tp = texture(surfaces, vec3(p * tiles_per_m.z, layer_ids.z)); vec4 tr = texture(surfaces, vec3((p + warp * 0.5) * rock_tiles_per_m, rock_layer)); te.ba = mix(vec2(0.5), te.ba, earth_bump); // the dirt tile's pebble bumps repeat: keep them low tr.ba = mix(vec2(0.5), tr.ba, rock_bump); // grazing sun on a shaded slope: strong bumps light up as flecks float er = mix(te.r, 0.5, clamp(far_k + near_break * Nn.r + open_calm * openness * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)); // breaks the pebble repeat float gr = mix(tg.r, 0.5, far_k); float rr = mix(tr.r, 0.5, far_k * 0.6); // M2W1 r2b: open_flat calms the colour patches on open ground (far from every trodden or sheltered place), so // the variation that remains means something (trodden, sheltered, slope). float flat_k = open_flat * openness; vec3 earth_col = mix(earth_umber, earth_ochre, mix(smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, L.g * 0.55 + M.r * 0.45), 0.6, flat_k)); earth_col = mix(earth_col, earth_worn, smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, M.b * 0.6 + M.g * 0.4) * earth_worn_amount * (1.0 - flat_k)); vec3 earth = earth_col * (1.0 + (er - 0.5) * earth_contrast); vec3 green_col = mix(grass_lush, grass_dry, mix(smoothstep(0.3, 0.72, L.r * 0.45 + M.g * 0.4 + M.b * 0.15), 0.45, flat_k * 0.7)); vec3 green = green_col * (1.0 + (gr - 0.5) * grass_contrast); vec3 creep_col = grass_dry * (1.0 + (gr - 0.5) * grass_contrast); vec3 rock_c = rock_color * (1.0 + (rr - 0.5) * rock_contrast); rock_c = mix(rock_c, earth, smoothstep(0.35, 0.75, M.b) * rock_scree); // loose earth between the stones vec3 stone = paving_color * (0.3 + 1.4 * mix(tp.r, 0.5, far_k * 0.5)) * (1.0 + (M.b - 0.5) * slab_tint); // Grass in the paving joints near the grass, a darker dirt band where the paving meets the earth. float joint = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.18, 0.32, tp.r); stone = mix(stone, green_col * 0.7, joint * grass_paint * paving_joint_grass); // Compacted aprons and tracks: paler, smoother earth; sheltered edges: darker, damp and greener. vec3 compacted = mix(trodden_color, compacted_soil.rgb, compacted_soil.a); earth = mix(earth, compacted * (1.0 + (er - 0.5) * trodden_contrast), trod * trodden_amount); vec3 albedo_d = mix(earth, creep_col, creep * smoothstep(0.45, 0.6, gr)); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, shelter_color * (1.0 + (gr - 0.5) * grass_contrast * 0.5), shel * shelter_amount); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, green, grass); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, grass_lush * 0.72 * (1.0 + (gr - 0.5) * grass_contrast * 0.5), shel * grass * shelter_amount); // lusher, darker grass in shelter albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, rock_c, rock); // The hill: a dark scree skirt at the base, tilted ochre strata up the flank, a pale limestone crown. float hb = h + (M.g - 0.5) * hill_band_noise_m * 2.0 + dot(p, hill_band_tilt); float strata = smoothstep(-0.35, 0.35, sin(hb * 6.2831853 / hill_band_m) + (M.b - 0.5) * 0.6); vec3 hill_col = mix(hill_ochre_b, hill_ochre_a, strata) * (1.0 + (rr - 0.5) * rock_contrast); hill_col = mix(hill_col, hill_skirt_color * (1.0 + (er - 0.5) * earth_contrast), 1.0 - smoothstep(hill_skirt_m * 0.6, hill_skirt_m * 1.4, hb)); hill_col = mix(hill_col, hill_crown_color * (1.0 + (rr - 0.5) * rock_contrast * 0.6), smoothstep(hill_crown_m - 2.5, hill_crown_m + 2.5, hb)); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, hill_col, hill_w * (1.0 - rock * hill_rock_keep)); float edge = clamp(paving * (1.0 - paving) * 4.0, 0.0, 1.0); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, stone, paving); albedo_d = mix(albedo_d, paving_edge_color, edge * paving_edge * (1.0 - grass_paint * 0.5)); // One value term over all of it at the three scales (calmer on open ground), then the near grain. albedo_d *= 1.0 + (L.g * 0.45 + M.g * 0.35 + M.b * 0.2 - 0.5) * 2.0 * macro_value * (1.0 - open_calm * openness); albedo_d *= 1.0 + (Nn.b - 0.5) * near_strength * near_k; // Open earth far from everything is a step darker than the aprons; contact darkens under clutter and wall feet. albedo_d *= 1.0 - open_dark * openness; albedo_d *= 1.0 - contact_dark * P.b; vec4 t_d = mix(mix(mix(te, tg, grass), tr, rock), tp, paving); float low_d = 1.0 - M.r * 0.6 - t_d.r * 0.25 - M.g * 0.15; float puddle_d = smoothstep(puddle_level, puddle_level + puddle_soft, low_d + wet * 0.5 - 0.5) * (1.0 - grass * 0.8) * (1.0 - rock) * step(0.001, wet); puddle_d *= 1.0 - smoothstep(puddle_far_m * 0.5, puddle_far_m, dist); // no distant mirror glints of the sun float damp_d = wet * (1.0 - grass * 0.5) * (1.0 - rock * 0.6); // rain runs off the slopes albedo_d *= mix(1.0, wet_dark, max(damp_d * 0.7, puddle_d)); ALBEDO = albedo_d; // Wet: the roughness varies with the near and mid noise, so the rain never makes one mirror of the ground. float wet_rough_d = wet_roughness + 0.25 + (Nn.g - 0.5) * wet_rough_vary + (M.r - 0.5) * wet_rough_vary; ROUGHNESS = mix(mix(t_d.g, wet_rough_d, damp_d * 0.6), puddle_roughness, puddle_d); vec2 n_d = (t_d.ba * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - puddle_d) * (1.0 - far_k * 0.8) * (1.0 - trod * trodden_smooth) + (Nn.gb - 0.5) * near_bump * near_k; vec3 tangent_d = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)).xyz); vec3 bitangent_d = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0)).xyz); NORMAL = normalize(NORMAL + tangent_d * n_d.x * 1.2 + bitangent_d * n_d.y * 1.2); SPECULAR = mix(ground_specular - rock * 0.25, puddle_specular, puddle_d); } else { vec4 paint = texture(paint_map, p / map_size_m + 0.5); vec4 nz = texture(noise_pack, p * macro_per_m); // A second, much larger sample for the broad patches, so the first one's tiling does not show from the air. vec4 wide = texture(noise_pack, p * macro_per_m * 0.27 + vec2(0.37, 0.11)); float verge = edge_blend_on * smoothstep(0.0, backdrop_edge_blend_m + 78.0, radius_m - verge_start + (wide.r - 0.5) * 46.0); float far_field = smoothstep(285.0, 780.0, radius_m + (wide.r - 0.5) * 65.0); float verge_grass = mix(mix(0.68, 0.95, wide.r), mix(0.36, 0.69, wide.r), far_field); paint = mix(paint, vec4(0.0, verge_grass, 0.0, 1.0), verge); float paving = smoothstep(0.42, 0.58, paint.r + (nz.b - 0.5) * edge_noise * 0.6); float grass = smoothstep(0.38, 0.62, paint.g + (nz.r - 0.5) * edge_noise) * (1.0 - paving); vec4 te = texture(surfaces, vec3(p * tiles_per_m.x, layer_ids.x)); vec4 tg = texture(surfaces, vec3(p * tiles_per_m.y, layer_ids.y)); vec4 tp = texture(surfaces, vec3(p * tiles_per_m.z, layer_ids.z)); vec3 earth = earth_color * (0.2 + 1.6 * te.r); // Two tones of grass in broad patches, with the blades' own light and dark on top. vec3 green = mix(grass_color, grass_dry_color, smoothstep(0.3, 0.75, wide.r * 0.7 + nz.g * 0.3)) * (0.05 + 1.9 * tg.r); vec3 stone = paving_color * (0.3 + 1.4 * tp.r); vec3 albedo = mix(mix(earth, green, grass), stone, paving); vec4 t = mix(mix(te, tg, grass), tp, paving); albedo *= 1.0 + (wide.g * 0.6 + nz.g * 0.4 - 0.5) * 2.0 * macro_strength; // Water gathers in the low noise first; paving joints hold it, grass hides it. float low = 1.0 - nz.r * 0.6 - t.r * 0.25 - nz.g * 0.15; float puddle = smoothstep(puddle_level, puddle_level + puddle_soft, low + wet * 0.5 - 0.5) * (1.0 - grass * 0.8) * step(0.001, wet); float damp = wet * (1.0 - grass * 0.5); albedo *= mix(1.0, wet_dark, max(damp * 0.7, puddle)); ALBEDO = albedo; ROUGHNESS = mix(mix(t.g, wet_roughness + 0.25, damp * 0.6), 0.04, puddle); vec2 n = (t.ba * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - puddle); // World-space mapping on a flat top: +u is world +x, +v is world +z. vec3 tangent = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)).xyz); vec3 bitangent = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0)).xyz); NORMAL = normalize(NORMAL + tangent * n.x * 1.2 + bitangent * n.y * 1.2); SPECULAR = mix(0.5, 0.9, puddle); } }
loot_glow.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled; // S6: the glow of a ground item, one batch for every item (instance colour = the item kind's colour). // UV2.x picks the part: 0 = a soft pulsing ring on the ground, 1 = a thin beam that fades with height. uniform float strength = 0.9; uniform float pulse_speed = 2.4; varying float v_part; varying float v_phase; void vertex() { v_part = UV2.x; v_phase = MODEL_MATRIX[3].x * 0.7 + MODEL_MATRIX[3].z * 1.3; } void fragment() { float alpha; if (v_part < 0.5) { float d = length(UV - 0.5) * 2.0; float pulse = 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(TIME * pulse_speed + v_phase); float ring = smoothstep(0.55, 0.82, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.86, 1.0, d)); alpha = (ring * 0.9 + (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.9, d)) * 0.18) * pulse; } else { float across = 1.0 - abs(UV.x - 0.5) * 2.0; alpha = across * across * pow(1.0 - UV.y, 1.8) * 0.55; } ALBEDO = COLOR.rgb * alpha * strength; ALPHA = 1.0; }
rain_splash.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled; // A raindrop's ring on the ground: grows and fades over the particle's life (INSTANCE_CUSTOM.y = age 0..1). uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(0.75, 0.82, 0.9, 0.4); varying float v_age; void vertex() { v_age = INSTANCE_CUSTOM.y; VERTEX.xz *= 0.25 + 0.75 * v_age; } void fragment() { float d = length(UV - 0.5) * 2.0; float ring = smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.85, 1.0, d)); ALBEDO = tint.rgb; ALPHA = ring * tint.a * (1.0 - v_age); }
sky_astra.gdshader: shader_type sky; // S1: the Alesia sky. A gradient from the zenith to a horizon that is warm towards the sun and cool away from // it, a sun (or moon) disc with a halo, one layer of clouds lit from the sun's side, and stars. Everything // comes from uniforms (data/art_look.json) and one generated noise texture; there is no sky image. // It does not read TIME, so the radiance map is built once and not every frame (Mobile renderer cost). uniform vec3 zenith_color : source_color = vec3(0.1, 0.14, 0.32); uniform vec3 horizon_color : source_color = vec3(0.45, 0.38, 0.5); uniform vec3 horizon_sun_color : source_color = vec3(0.95, 0.55, 0.32); uniform vec3 ground_color : source_color = vec3(0.12, 0.1, 0.1); uniform float horizon_power = 3.0; uniform float sun_spread = 5.0; uniform vec3 sun_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.72, 0.45); uniform float sun_energy = 10.0; uniform float sun_size_deg = 2.4; uniform float sun_halo = 0.5; uniform sampler2D noise_pack : filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; uniform float cloud_cover = 0.5; uniform float cloud_soft = 0.18; uniform float cloud_scale = 0.35; uniform vec2 cloud_offset = vec2(0.0); uniform vec3 cloud_lit_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.6, 0.42); uniform vec3 cloud_dark_color : source_color = vec3(0.2, 0.18, 0.3); uniform float star_energy = 0.0; // M2W1 (optional; the defaults draw exactly the S1 sky). Cloud light: one more fetch of the low octave a step // towards the sun; where the cloud thins towards the sun the edge is lit, where it thickens the side is in shade. uniform float cloud_light_step = 0.0; uniform float cloud_light_gain = 3.0; uniform float cloud_light_mix = 0.0; uniform vec3 cloud_base_color : source_color = vec3(0.2, 0.18, 0.3); uniform float cloud_base = 0.0; // High thin streaks above the cumulus (two fetches; skipped at cloud2_cover 0). uniform float cloud2_cover = 0.0; uniform float cloud2_scale = 0.12; uniform float cloud2_stretch = 3.0; uniform vec2 cloud2_offset = vec2(0.31, 0.07); uniform vec3 cloud2_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.95, 0.88); uniform float cloud2_opacity = 0.5; // A pale band along the horizon (math only), warmer on the sun's side. uniform float horizon_haze = 0.0; uniform float horizon_haze_width = 0.08; uniform vec3 horizon_haze_color : source_color = vec3(0.8, 0.78, 0.74); uniform vec3 horizon_haze_sun_color : source_color = vec3(0.95, 0.85, 0.7); // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) works in sRGB space: the source_color uniforms above arrive unconverted // and COLOR is taken as sRGB (OUTPUT_IS_SRGB). The sky adds small linear energies (stars, the halo's wide term, // the moon's glow), which then stayed near black on the web. There, LIN() turns each colour to linear, the sky is // mixed exactly as on Mobile, and the result goes back to sRGB at the end. Mobile and Forward+ compile LIN(c) as // (c) and write COLOR = color, unchanged. #define LIN(c) (c) // M2W1 astraB (optional; 0 = the S1 cloud light). The S1 clouds take the sun's side from the azimuth alone, so every // thin cloud in the sun's compass direction is lit at any height: a vertical glow column through the sun. At 1 the // clouds take it from the angle to the sun (a round warm area round the sun) and the light is capped at 1. uniform float cloud_sun_3d = 0.0; uniform float cloud_sun_spread = 3.0; // power on (dot(dir, sun) * 0.5 + 0.5) for that round area // The halo's wide term (S1: 0.18 of sun_halo); lower keeps the sky round the sun deep. uniform float sun_halo_wide = 0.18; void sky() { vec3 dir = normalize(EYEDIR); float up = dir.y; vec3 sun_dir = LIGHT0_ENABLED ? LIGHT0_DIRECTION : vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); float towards = dot(dir, sun_dir); float side = pow(clamp(dot(normalize(dir.xz + vec2(0.0001)), normalize(sun_dir.xz + vec2(0.0001))) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), sun_spread); float low = pow(1.0 - clamp(up, 0.0, 1.0), horizon_power); vec3 horizon = mix(LIN(horizon_color), LIN(horizon_sun_color), side); vec3 color = mix(LIN(zenith_color), horizon, low); // Stars before the clouds, so clouds cover them. if (star_energy > 0.0) { vec2 suv = dir.xz / (abs(up) + 0.35) * 1.7; float star = texture(noise_pack, suv).a * texture(noise_pack, suv * 0.23 + 0.31).g; color += vec3(0.85, 0.9, 1.0) * star * star_energy * smoothstep(0.02, 0.4, up); } float halo = pow(max(towards, 0.0), 48.0) * sun_halo + pow(max(towards, 0.0), 6.0) * sun_halo * sun_halo_wide; color += LIN(sun_color) * halo; float cloud_side = mix(side, pow(clamp(towards * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), cloud_sun_spread), cloud_sun_3d); float cloud = 0.0; if (up > 0.0 && cloud2_cover > 0.0) { vec2 uv2 = dir.xz / (up + 0.25) * cloud2_scale * vec2(1.0, cloud2_stretch) + cloud2_offset; float n2 = texture(noise_pack, uv2).g * 0.7 + texture(noise_pack, uv2 * vec2(3.1, 1.3) + 0.53).r * 0.3; float streak = smoothstep(1.0 - cloud2_cover, 1.0 - cloud2_cover + 0.28, n2) * smoothstep(0.03, 0.3, up); vec3 streak_color = mix(LIN(cloud2_color) * 0.82, LIN(cloud2_color), cloud_side); color = mix(color, mix(streak_color, horizon, low * 0.6), streak * cloud2_opacity); } if (up > 0.0) { vec2 uv = dir.xz / (up + 0.16) * cloud_scale + cloud_offset; float n0 = texture(noise_pack, uv * 0.35).r; float n = n0 * 0.62 + texture(noise_pack, uv * 0.93 + 0.37).r * 0.28 + texture(noise_pack, uv * 2.9).g * 0.1; cloud = smoothstep(1.0 - cloud_cover - cloud_soft, 1.0 - cloud_cover + cloud_soft, n) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, up); // Thick cores are dark; thin edges and the side towards the sun catch its colour. float core = smoothstep(1.0 - cloud_cover, 1.0 - cloud_cover + 0.35, n); float lit = clamp((1.0 - core * 0.85) * (0.35 + 0.65 * cloud_side) + pow(max(towards, 0.0), 10.0) * 0.6, 0.0, mix(1.5, 1.0, cloud_sun_3d)); if (cloud_light_mix > 0.0) { vec2 sun_uv = normalize(sun_dir.xz + vec2(0.0001)) * cloud_light_step; float n_sun = texture(noise_pack, (uv + sun_uv) * 0.35).r; float facing_sun = clamp((n0 - n_sun) * cloud_light_gain + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0); lit = mix(lit, lit * (0.35 + 1.3 * facing_sun), cloud_light_mix); } vec3 cloud_color = mix(LIN(cloud_dark_color), LIN(cloud_lit_color), lit); // Bases: the thick part of a cloud, seen from below, goes to the base colour. cloud_color = mix(cloud_color, LIN(cloud_base_color), core * cloud_base * (1.0 - 0.5 * cloud_side)); cloud_color = mix(cloud_color, horizon, low * 0.75); color = mix(color, cloud_color, cloud); } if (!AT_CUBEMAP_PASS) { float edge = cos(radians(sun_size_deg)); float disc = smoothstep(edge, mix(edge, 1.0, 0.3), towards); color += LIN(sun_color) * sun_energy * disc * (1.0 - cloud * 0.85); } color = mix(color, LIN(ground_color), smoothstep(0.0, -0.12, up)); if (horizon_haze > 0.0) { float band = exp(-abs(up) / max(horizon_haze_width, 0.001)); color = mix(color, mix(LIN(horizon_haze_color), LIN(horizon_haze_sun_color), side), band * horizon_haze); } COLOR = color; }
soldier_armor.gdshader: shader_type spatial; // One material for every soldier (C3, decision D2). The vertex colour is the paint, authored as sRGB. // Where the vertex alpha is 0 the paint is the squad colour: a per-instance value, so squads differ // without a second material. Alpha 1 keeps the vertex colour. // squad_paint is plain sRGB numbers (a vec3 without a colour hint), so nothing converts it on the way in // and the one conversion below treats both paints the same. // The default below is never meant to be seen: SoldierSquadColour sets it from data. Pure green marks an // instance nobody painted (not magenta: that is the Fold diagnostic clear colour the device harness counts). // S4: the paint sits on a textured surface like the world's (UV2.x = surface id, one array fetch: R albedo // modulation, G roughness, B / A normal), with a rim light so a soldier reads against a dark wall, and a // second per-instance value for the armor tier: vertices of the tier surface take tier_paint.rgb, and // tier_paint.a makes them glow. const int SURFACES = 32; instance uniform vec3 squad_paint = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); instance uniform vec4 tier_paint = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0); // a < 0: no tier, keep the vertex paint uniform sampler2DArray surfaces : filter_linear_mipmap_anisotropic, repeat_enable; uniform vec4 surf_a[SURFACES]; // layer, tiles per metre, contrast, bump uniform vec4 surf_b[SURFACES]; // roughness scale, roughness bias, metallic, glow uniform int tier_surface = -1; instance uniform float cape_lift = 0.0; uniform int sway_surface = -1; // parts with "sway": true must use this surface (their UV2.y is the hang, not a shade) uniform float sway_m = 0.04; uniform float sway_lift_m = 0.3; uniform float sway_speed = 2.6; uniform float part_shade = 0.05; uniform float ambient_down = 0.45; uniform vec3 rim_color : source_color = vec3(0.55, 0.7, 1.0); uniform float rim = 0.35; uniform float rim_power = 3.0; uniform float glow_pulse = 0.12; uniform float glow_pulse_speed = 1.7; uniform float wet = 0.0; uniform float wet_dark = 0.62; uniform float wet_roughness = 0.12; varying flat int v_surface; varying vec3 v_world_normal; varying float v_tier_glow; // The sRGB to linear step StandardMaterial3D applies with vertex_color_is_srgb. vec3 to_linear(vec3 c) { return mix(pow((c + vec3(0.055)) * (1.0 / 1.055), vec3(2.4)), c * (1.0 / 12.92), lessThan(c, vec3(0.04045))); } // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) shades in sRGB space: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB is true there, source_color // uniforms (rim_color) and light colours arrive unconverted, and StandardMaterial3D skips its vertex_color_is_srgb // step. This paint is linear (to_linear in vertex()), which darkened the dark and mid paints (belt, trims, squad // stripes) on the web. There, takes a source_color to linear, paint and emission are worked out as on // Mobile, and hands them over in sRGB. Mobile and Forward+ compile c and c as (c). #define W1A_LIN(c) (c) #define W1A_OUT(c) (c) void vertex() { v_surface = int(UV2.x + 0.5); vec3 paint = mix(squad_paint, COLOR.rgb, COLOR.a); v_tier_glow = 0.0; if (v_surface == tier_surface && tier_paint.a >= 0.0) { paint = tier_paint.rgb; v_tier_glow = tier_paint.a; } float shade = UV2.y; if (v_surface == sway_surface) { // The cape: UV2.y is how far the vertex hangs below the cape's top edge (0..1). It ripples, and // swings back (the soldier's +Z) and up with cape_lift, the soldier's speed as a fraction. float hang = UV2.y * UV2.y; float ripple = sin(TIME * sway_speed + UV2.y * 4.0 + squad_paint.r * 9.0) * sway_m; VERTEX.z += (ripple + cape_lift * sway_lift_m) * hang; VERTEX.x += cos(TIME * sway_speed * 0.7 + UV2.y * 3.0) * sway_m * 0.4 * hang; VERTEX.y += cape_lift * sway_lift_m * 0.45 * hang; shade = 0.5; } COLOR.rgb = to_linear(paint) * (1.0 + (shade - 0.5) * 2.0 * part_shade); v_world_normal = normalize(MODEL_NORMAL_MATRIX * NORMAL); } void fragment() { vec4 a = surf_a[v_surface]; vec4 b = surf_b[v_surface]; vec4 t = texture(surfaces, vec3(UV * a.y, a.x)); float up = v_world_normal.y; vec3 paint = COLOR.rgb * (1.0 + a.z * (t.r * 2.0 - 1.0)); float rough = clamp(t.g * b.x + b.y, 0.04, 1.0); float soaked = wet * smoothstep(0.2, 0.9, up) * (1.0 - b.z); paint *= mix(1.0, wet_dark, wet * (1.0 - b.z) * 0.5); ALBEDO = paint; ROUGHNESS = mix(rough, wet_roughness, soaked); METALLIC = b.z; vec2 n = (t.ba * 2.0 - 1.0) * a.w; vec3 normal = normalize(NORMAL + TANGENT * n.x + BINORMAL * n.y); NORMAL = normal; AO = mix(ambient_down, 1.0, up * 0.5 + 0.5); AO_LIGHT_AFFECT = 0.0; float pulse = 1.0 + glow_pulse * sin(TIME * glow_pulse_speed); float edge = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(normal, VIEW), 0.0, 1.0), rim_power); EMISSION = paint * ((b.w + v_tier_glow) * pulse) + rim_color * (edge * rim * (0.4 + 0.6 * clamp(up + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0))); }
sun_shaft.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, world_vertex_coords, fog_disabled; // A sun shaft: one quad per place, stretched along the sun's direction from the instance's origin and turned // around that axis to face the camera. Additive, soft at the edges, brighter when the view looks towards the // sun, faded out close to the camera. No depth or screen read (cheap; overdraw is its only cost). uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.66, 0.4, 1.0); uniform float strength = 0.13; uniform float length_m = 34.0; uniform float width_m = 5.0; uniform vec3 axis = vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); uniform sampler2D noise_pack : filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; varying float v_fade; varying vec2 v_noise_uv; void vertex() { vec3 origin = MODEL_MATRIX[3].xyz; vec3 dir = normalize(axis); vec3 on_axis = origin + dir * (UV.y * length_m); vec3 to_camera = CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD - on_axis; vec3 side = normalize(cross(dir, to_camera)); VERTEX = on_axis + side * ((UV.x - 0.5) * width_m); NORMAL = normalize(to_camera); float along_view = dot(normalize(-to_camera), -dir); // 1 = looking straight up the shaft at the sun float facing = clamp(along_view * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0); // Seen end-on a quad is a wedge, not a shaft: fade it out there, and close to the camera. float side_on = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.75, 0.97, abs(along_view)); v_fade = (0.35 + 0.65 * facing * facing) * side_on * smoothstep(6.0, 18.0, length(to_camera)); v_noise_uv = vec2(origin.x * 0.07 + UV.x * 0.6, origin.z * 0.05); } void fragment() { float across = sin(UV.x * PI); float along = smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, UV.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, UV.y)); float streaks = 0.55 + 0.45 * texture(noise_pack, v_noise_uv).g; ALBEDO = tint.rgb; ALPHA = across * across * along * streaks * strength * v_fade; }
vignette.gdshader: shader_type canvas_item; // Darkens the corners of the 3D view. A plain blended rectangle: it does not read the screen. uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(0.02, 0.02, 0.06, 1.0); uniform float strength = 0.38; uniform float inner = 0.55; uniform float outer = 1.25; void fragment() { vec2 p = (UV - 0.5) * 2.0; COLOR = vec4(tint.rgb, smoothstep(inner, outer, length(p)) * strength); }
world_cloth.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode cull_disabled; // Banners and tent cloth (WorldAmbient). S7: the cloth takes light on both sides, ripples in two waves that // grow away from the pole (UV.x = 0 is the fixed edge), shows a woven surface from the shared surface array, // and carries a trim: a gold band near the free edge and one across the top. Uniform names amplitude, speed, // frequency, base_color and roughness are the ones WorldAmbient has always set. uniform float amplitude; uniform float speed; uniform float frequency; uniform vec4 base_color : source_color; uniform float roughness; uniform sampler2DArray surfaces : filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; uniform float cloth_layer = 6.0; uniform float weave_per_uv = 5.0; uniform vec3 trim_color : source_color = vec3(0.85, 0.62, 0.2); uniform float trim = 1.0; varying float v_fold; // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) shades in sRGB space: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB is true there and base_color / // trim_color (source_color) arrive unconverted, so the weave and fold factors below darkened sRGB values on the web // (banners and tents too dark). There, takes the colours to linear, the albedo is worked out as on // Mobile and hands it over in sRGB. Mobile and Forward+ compile c and c as (c). #define W1A_LIN(c) (c) #define W1A_OUT(c) (c) void vertex() { float t = TIME * speed; float reach = UV.x; float wave = sin(t + UV.x * frequency) * 0.7 + sin(t * 1.7 + UV.x * frequency * 2.3 + UV.y * 3.0) * 0.3; VERTEX.z += wave * amplitude * reach; VERTEX.y += sin(t * 0.8 + UV.x * frequency * 0.6) * amplitude * 0.25 * reach; // The fold's slope shades the cloth: a cheap stand-in for recomputed normals. v_fold = cos(t + UV.x * frequency) * reach; } void fragment() { vec4 weave = texture(surfaces, vec3(UV * weave_per_uv, cloth_layer)); vec3 color = base_color.rgb * (0.7 + 0.6 * weave.r); float band = step(0.82, UV.x) * step(UV.x, 0.9) + step(UV.y, 0.1) * step(0.03, UV.y); color = mix(color, trim_color * (0.7 + 0.6 * weave.r), clamp(band, 0.0, 1.0) * trim); ALBEDO = color * (0.82 + 0.18 * v_fold); ROUGHNESS = roughness; }
world_foliage.gdshader: shader_type spatial; render_mode cull_disabled; // Grass tufts (WorldAmbient): one batch. S7: a tuft is a few blades; the vertex colour runs dark at the root // to light at the tip, the tip sways with a gust that travels across the field, and the blades take the // ground's light (their normal points up) so a tuft never flashes dark when a blade turns edge-on. uniform float amplitude; uniform float speed; uniform float frequency; uniform float height_m; uniform vec4 base_color : source_color; uniform float roughness; // M2W1 astraB (optional; the defaults draw exactly as before). solid_by_alpha 1: a vertex whose colour alpha is // below 0.5 is a solid part merged into a clutter patch (a stone): it neither sways nor takes the upward normal. // fade_to_m > 0: an instance shrinks into the ground between fade_from_m and fade_to_m from the camera (its origin), // so patches end softly instead of at the batch's range. uniform float solid_by_alpha = 0.0; uniform float fade_from_m = 0.0; uniform float fade_to_m = 0.0; // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) shades in sRGB space: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB is true there and base_color // (source_color) arrives unconverted. The vertex colours are linear (world_clutter.gd turns the clutter's linear // when the mesh is made), so on the web the stones merged into clutter patches drew near black. There, // takes base_color to linear, the albedo is worked out as on Mobile and hands it over in sRGB. Mobile and // Forward+ compile c and c as (c), unchanged. #define W1A_LIN(c) (c) #define W1A_OUT(c) (c) void vertex() { float blade = mix(1.0, step(0.5, COLOR.a), solid_by_alpha); float weight = clamp(VERTEX.y / height_m, 0.0, 1.0) * blade; vec3 world = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz; float gust = sin(TIME * speed + world.x * frequency * 0.35 + world.z * frequency * 0.22) * 0.7 + sin(TIME * speed * 2.3 + world.x * 1.7) * 0.3; VERTEX.x += gust * amplitude * weight * weight; VERTEX.z += gust * amplitude * 0.4 * weight * weight; if (fade_to_m > 0.0) { float d = length(MODEL_MATRIX[3].xyz - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD); VERTEX *= 1.0 - smoothstep(fade_from_m, fade_to_m, d); } NORMAL = normalize(mix(NORMAL, (inverse(MODEL_MATRIX) * vec4(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0)).xyz, blade)); } void fragment() { if (!FRONT_FACING) { NORMAL = -NORMAL; // the engine turns a back face's normal round; a blade is lit the same from both sides } ALBEDO = base_color.rgb * COLOR.rgb; ROUGHNESS = roughness; }
world_surface.gdshader: shader_type spatial; // One material for the built world (kit pieces, cover, walls, props). A vertex carries its paint (COLOR, sRGB), // the surface id of that paint (UV2.x, data/art_materials.json "surface_order") and a per-part shade (UV2.y). // UV is in metres on the face's main plane and TANGENT follows +u (LowpolyKit._triangle), so one texture // fetch gives the surface: R = albedo modulation, G = roughness, B / A = tangent-space normal x / y. // Cost: one array fetch per pixel, no screen or depth read; runs on the Mobile renderer. const int SURFACES = 32; uniform sampler2DArray surfaces : filter_linear_mipmap_anisotropic, repeat_enable; uniform vec4 surf_a[SURFACES]; // layer, tiles per metre, contrast, bump uniform vec4 surf_b[SURFACES]; // roughness scale, roughness bias, metallic, glow uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0); uniform float paint_mix = 1.0; // 0 = tint only (pieces without vertex paint), 1 = tint x vertex paint uniform float part_shade = 0.08; // how far UV2.y moves a part lighter or darker uniform float ambient_down = 0.45; uniform vec3 bounce_color : source_color = vec3(1.0, 0.62, 0.38); uniform float bounce = 0.07; uniform float grime_height = 0.9; uniform float grime_dark = 0.72; uniform float glow_pulse = 0.12; uniform float glow_pulse_speed = 1.7; uniform float wet = 0.0; uniform float wet_dark = 0.62; uniform float wet_roughness = 0.12; // M2W1 astraA: world-kit looks (scripts/visual/world_kit_meshes.gd: glb structures, parts cover) carry CUSTOM0 = // (variation weight, baked shade range, grime kept, 0); every other mesh has none (reads 0) and takes exactly the // old path. A look with a shade range reads UV2.y over that range (its shade is baked at load) and keeps CUSTOM0.z // of the world-height grime; with a weight it takes a per-instance value / warmth from its origin (MODEL_MATRIX: // the batch instance, so a near and a far mesh of one piece match; cells of variation_cell_m, a broad wave of // variation_broad_m). The variation uniforms default to 0 (off); WorldKit sets them when the looks are on. uniform float variation_value = 0.0; uniform float variation_warm = 0.0; uniform float variation_broad = 0.0; uniform float variation_cell_m = 8.0; uniform float variation_broad_m = 70.0; // M2W1 astraB: the look variant's "glow_gain" (data/art_look.json; absent = 1.0, the emission as before) scales the // surfaces' own glow (energy lines, lamps, beacons), not the bounce term. uniform float glow_gain = 1.0; // M2W1 astraB: the wet gloss fades out between half this and this camera distance (default: never), so far hills // in the storm do not flash the light back. uniform float wet_far_m = 100000.0; varying flat int v_surface; varying vec3 v_world; varying vec3 v_world_normal; varying float v_grime; // A sin-free hash (fract / dot only: a large sin argument loses precision on GPUs and gave neighbouring cells // nearly the same value). float cell_hash(vec2 c) { vec3 p = fract(vec3(c.xyx) * 0.1031); p += dot(p, p.yzx + 33.33); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z); } // The sRGB to linear step StandardMaterial3D applies with vertex_color_is_srgb. vec3 to_linear(vec3 c) { return mix(pow((c + vec3(0.055)) * (1.0 / 1.055), vec3(2.4)), c * (1.0 / 12.92), lessThan(c, vec3(0.04045))); } // W1a: the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) shades in sRGB space: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB is true there, source_color // uniforms (tint, bounce_color) and light colours arrive unconverted, and StandardMaterial3D skips its // vertex_color_is_srgb step. CUSTOM0.y : part_shade)); v_grime = kit ? CUSTOM0.z : 1.0; if (CUSTOM0.x > 0.0) { vec3 origin = MODEL_MATRIX[3].xyz; vec2 cell = floor(origin.xz / variation_cell_m); float h0 = cell_hash(cell); float h1 = cell_hash(cell + vec2(17.0, 5.0)); float wave = sin(origin.x * 6.2831853 / variation_broad_m) * cos(origin.z * 6.2831853 / (variation_broad_m * 1.37)); float value = 1.0 + CUSTOM0.x * ((h0 * 2.0 - 1.0) * variation_value + wave * variation_broad); float warm = CUSTOM0.x * (h1 * 2.0 - 1.0) * variation_warm; COLOR.rgb *= value * vec3(1.0 + warm, 1.0, 1.0 - warm); } v_world = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz; v_world_normal = normalize(MODEL_NORMAL_MATRIX * NORMAL); } void fragment() { vec4 a = surf_a[v_surface]; vec4 b = surf_b[v_surface]; vec4 t = texture(surfaces, vec3(UV * a.y, a.x)); float up = v_world_normal.y; vec3 paint = COLOR.rgb * tint.rgb * (1.0 + a.z * (t.r * 2.0 - 1.0)); // Dirt creeps up from the ground on faces that do not look up. float foot = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, grime_height, v_world.y)) * (1.0 - max(up, 0.0)) * v_grime; paint *= mix(1.0, grime_dark, foot * (0.6 + 0.4 * t.r)); float rough = clamp(t.g * b.x + b.y, 0.04, 1.0); float soaked = wet * smoothstep(0.2, 0.9, up) * (1.0 - b.z) * (1.0 - smoothstep(wet_far_m * 0.5, wet_far_m, length(v_world - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD))); paint *= mix(1.0, wet_dark, wet * (1.0 - b.z) * 0.6); ALBEDO = paint; ROUGHNESS = mix(rough, wet_roughness, soaked); METALLIC = b.z; vec2 n = (t.ba * 2.0 - 1.0) * a.w * (1.0 - soaked * 0.7); NORMAL = normalize(NORMAL + TANGENT * n.x + BINORMAL * n.y); // Ambient is one colour (Environment), so shape it here: faces that look down keep less of it.
